Astra Education
Interview Experience
Sahil Kedare
TY Computer Engineering

Introduction
Astra visited our campus VJTI on 21st Jan 2022, to hire interns for the 2022 Summer internship
for the role of Front-end and Back-end web developer. All the branches were eligible for the role.
We had to fill a google form where we had to write about ourselves in 3-4 lines and submit our
resume on the basis that 68 candidates were shortlisted.
Round 1 : Task
There were two tasks, one for front-end and one for backend. I received the tasks on 25th of Jan
and it had to be submitted on or before 27th jan . We could do either one of the tasks or both of
them.
I decided to do the frontend task where I had to make a responsive website using React. They
had provided the details of the task in a figma file with images of the desktop and mobile views of
the website. Also we had to deploy it and submit the code along with the deployed site.
I submitted the task on 27th jan 3.30pm and at 7pm we received an email from astra that the
deadline for the task has been shifted to 28th jan 5pm. So I spent some time refactoring my code
and improving my UI and then resubmitted it.
Round 2 : Technical Interview
On 31st Jan TPO shared the list of selected candidates for the interview round. Out of 68
candidates who submitted the task  12 were selected and I was one of them.
They personally called all the selected candidates and fixed the timings. My interview was
scheduled on 2nd Feb 2021 on google meet at 4pm.
There were two interviewers. They were friendly and introduced themselves first then asked me
to do the same. Then they asked me to present my screen and show the website by running the
code. I had a doubt in a particular section of the task but I implemented it on the basis of what I
understood from the instructions they had provided. They were observing my work closely and
told me that the section in which I had doubt had to be done in a different way. So they explained
to me exactly what was expected and asked me to correct it onspot. I was not able to correct it
fully as I was getting some syntax errors but was able to convey the method to correct it. This
discussion lasted for almost 20 minutes.
1

Some of the questions related to react were :
●
What is Virtual dom?
●
Advantages of react?
●
React Hooks
Then they asked me if I had Computer Networks in my syllabus till now. I said yes and they
started asking me questions on it. They asked me 2  questions :
●
What is VPN and explain it in detail
●
What happens when you type a URL in the browser and press enter?
At first I was surprised as I was not expecting questions on CN but here the key is to remain calm
,not panic and confidently answer the questions . I answered both of the questions and they
seemed satisfied with my answers. Also in between they were constantly asking me small
questions.
Then they asked me to rate myself in DBMS and asked me to design a database for school
management system and use a notepad to explain it. After that they asked me some questions
●
Find the number of students enrolled in particular course
●
What is normalization? Why is it important?
●
I was asked to normalize the database
Further they asked me to rate myself in DSA and asked me the types of binary trees. Then they
asked me to mention the Data Structures I know. Then we had a discussion about arrays and
linked lists, their methods, time complexities etc. They seemed impressed. Other candidates
were asked to solve dsa questions some of the questions were :
●
Find minimum no of platforms
●
Find Next greater element
2

Then the HR ROUND started from here ,
Two more people joined the meet and introduced themselves and then asked me to do the
same. I understood that it was the HR part of the interview. One of the two interviewers who
joined was working in Byjus so he asked me if it is a good company or a bad one, we had a
casual discussion on it. Further they asked me 5 to 6 rapid fire questions like curiosity or
efficiency and other choice questions which was followed by this question:
Considering you have all the resources, power and money, what problem would you like to
solve?
I told them I would like to change the education system the way assessment is conducted and
make it focused more on learning rather than rote learning. We had a big discussion on it.
Then they asked me whether I had any questions for them. Please do ask questions it shows your
interest in the company. This demonstrates how interested and enthusiastic you are about this
internship.
I asked them
●
About my roles and responsibilities
●
Tech stack and technologies which they use and What projects will we be working on
during    our internship?
Conclusion :
The results were announced the next day, out of 9 students 2 students were selected for the
summer internship for the full time and I was one of them 😊.
3

Important Tips :
For DSA & CS Fundamentals :
●
Practice problems from 450dsa.com, GeeksForGeeksand Leetcode.
●
Do refer to this, it has all the resources for preparation.
●
Make sure you prepare CS Fundamentals along with DSA. Study them thoroughly.
●
For DBMS I referred to Sanchit Jain’s DBMS playlist and gfg.
●
For OS I referred to Gate Smashers and gfg.
●
For CN I referred  to Gate Smashers and gfg.
●
Refer this doc, it will answer most of your questions regarding preparations and
resources.Be prepared with all the concepts from each of them very clearly
For Interviews:
●
The most important thing is to stay calm and be confident. A lot depends on your
confidence.
●
Join the interview link at least 5 minutes prior to the time allotted to you. It gives an
impression that you are punctual.
●
While explaining CS Fundamentals, always try to give a real-world example.
●
If you don’t know the answer for any specific questions, simply say NO to the interviewer
rather than bluffing in front of the interviewer.
●
Dont Lie in your resume or don't mention anything which you would not be able to
answer. Always we honest.
●
Prepare your introduction by heart, don't leave it for the end.
●
Practice HR questions and research well about the company.
●
Always ask questions at the end of the interview. It shows your interest in their company.
LUCK🤞 plays a very vital role in the internship drive. Try to learn from the rejections and keep
improving yourself and try to do your best in the next one 😊.
ALL THE BEST 👍.
4
